title: How to Install Track Lighting | All About Lights (Ask This Old House) — Practical Kitchen Track Lighting Upgrade

summary: This Old House’s Ask This Old House episode demonstrates upgrading a single kitchen overhead light to a flexible track lighting system. The video distinguishes task lighting (near countertops and prep areas) from general lighting (for the table and room), then presents track lighting as a finish-friendly, surface-mounted option when ceiling wiring is constrained. The host walks through planning, power routing with a floating feed, cutting track to length, pre-assembling connectors, mounting with toggle bolts in a non-structural ceiling, wiring the track, installing individual fixture heads, and finally adding a pendant with an LED bulb and dimmer, highlighting LED efficiency advantages.
topics: track length options (4 ft and 8 ft)
toggle bolts for mounting without structural backing
track light heads with two prongs and locking collar
